#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <climits>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 10;
const int INF = 1e9;

struct Edge {
    int to, cap, rev;
    Edge(int t, int c, int r) : to(t), cap(c), rev(r) {}
};

vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
vector<int> level, ptr;

bool bfs(int s, int t) {
    fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(s);
    level[s] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (const Edge& e : graph[u]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                q.push(e.to);
            }
        }
    }
    return level[t] != -1;
}

int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
    if (u == t) return flow;
    for (int& i = ptr[u]; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
        Edge& e = graph[u][i];
        if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[u] + 1) {
            int pushed = dfs(e.to, t, min(flow, e.cap));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.cap -= pushed;
                graph[e.to][e.rev].cap += pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
    int total = 0;
    while (bfs(s, t)) {
        fill(ptr.begin(), ptr.end(), 0);
        while (int pushed = dfs(s, t, INF)) {
            total += pushed;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

int n, t;
char grid[MAXN][MAXN];
int scientists[MAXN][MAXN];
int capsules[MAXN][MAXN];
int dist[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN * MAXN];

int dx[4] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
int dy[4] = {0, 0, 1, -1};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> t;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> grid[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> scientists[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> capsules[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    // BFS from each reactor to compute infection time for each cell
    vector<pair<int, int>> reactors;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') {
                reactors.push_back({i, j});
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Initialize distance array
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= t; ++k) {
                dist[i][j][k] = INF;
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Multi-source BFS
    queue<tuple<int, int, int>> q;
    for (auto& reactor : reactors) {
        int x = reactor.first, y = reactor.second;
        dist[x][y][0] = 0;
        q.push({x, y, 0});
    }
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y, d] = q.front(); q.pop();
        if (d >= t) continue;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
            if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && grid[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                if (dist[nx][ny][d + 1] == INF) {
                    dist[nx][ny][d + 1] = d + 1;
                    q.push({nx, ny, d + 1});
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Build flow network
    int source = 0;
    int sink = 1;
    int lab_node = 2;
    int total_nodes = 2 + n * n;
    graph.resize(total_nodes);
    level.resize(total_nodes);
    ptr.resize(total_nodes);
    
    // Connect source to reactors with capacity = scientists in reactor
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') {
                if (scientists[i][j] > 0) {
                    graph[source].push_back(Edge(lab_node + i * n + j, scientists[i][j], graph[lab_node + i * n + j].size()));
                    graph[lab_node + i * n + j].push_back(Edge(source, 0, graph[source].size() - 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect labs to sink with capacity = capsules in lab
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y') {
                if (capsules[i][j] > 0) {
                    graph[lab_node + i * n + j].push_back(Edge(sink, capsules[i][j], graph[sink].size()));
                    graph[sink].push_back(Edge(lab_node + i * n + j, 0, graph[lab_node + i * n + j].size() - 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Connect adjacent labs with infinite capacity edges
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] != 'Y') {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni >= 0 && nj >= 0 && ni < n && nj < n && grid[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                        graph[lab_node + i * n + j].push_back(Edge(lab_node + ni * n + nj, INF, graph[lab_node + ni * n + nj].size()));
                        graph[lab_node + ni * n + nj].push_back(Edge(lab_node + i * n + j, 0, graph[lab_node + i * n + j].size() - 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // For each reactor, find reachable labs within t minutes and add edges
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Y') {
                // BFS from this reactor
                vector<vector<int>> minTime(n, vector<int>(n, INF));
                queue<pair<int, int>> bfsQ;
                minTime[i][j] = 0;
                bfsQ.push({i, j});
                
                while (!bfsQ.empty()) {
                    auto [x, y] = bfsQ.front(); bfsQ.pop();
                    if (minTime[x][y] >= t) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < n && ny < n && grid[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                            if (minTime[nx][ny] == INF) {
                                minTime[nx][ny] = minTime[x][y] + 1;
                                bfsQ.push({nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Add edges from reactor to reachable labs
                for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                        if (grid[x][y] != 'Y' && minTime[x][y] <= t && scientists[i][j] > 0) {
                            graph[lab_node + i * n + j].push_back(Edge(lab_node + x * n + y, scientists[i][j], graph[lab_node + x * n + y].size()));
                            graph[lab_node + x * n + y].push_back(Edge(lab_node + i * n + j, 0, graph[lab_node + i * n + j].size() - 1));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << maxFlow(source, sink) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
